description: Ciclovias is a dataset listed in City of São Paulo open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Companhia de Engenharia de Tráfego - CET. Atualizado em: 26/06/2026 Dados sobre a Infraestrutura Cicloviária da cidade de São Paulo dedicadas compostas por ciclovias, ciclofaixas, calçadas partilhadas, calçadas compartilhadas e ciclorrotas. Para maiores informações, acessar:. Coverage: São Paulo. The portal files it under the publisher Companhia de Engenharia de Tráfego - CET. Its tags are bicicleta, ciclofaixa, ciclorrota, ciclovias, mobilidade. It offers 12 resource(s) in .ZIP, CSV, ODS, XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-spcity-portal.
